automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.rule: Only public sources visibly published or updated within the last seven days relative to run time qualify.

qualifying_updates.title: Knowledge-Based Pull Requests: A Trusted Workflow for Agent-Mediated Knowledge Collaboration
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The paper proposes treating external collaborator code, tests, and cleaned agent traces as knowledge sources, packaging them into reviewer-facing artifacts, and regenerating candidate code inside the receiving project under local context, tests, and policy.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It gives source-workflow and review leaves a concrete public pattern for separating knowledge intake from merge decisions, preserving provenance, and routing external agent work through project-owned verification.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Future ingest should consider whether KPR-style knowledge packages belong as a durable source-workflow lens and whether code review rubrics should distinguish knowledge acceptance from implementation acceptance.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Review alongside existing raw-project-wiki-monitor and source-reconciliation pages before any docs/wiki synthesis.

qualifying_updates.title: A Deterministic Control Plane for LLM Coding Agents
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The paper describes an agent-harness control plane with canonical registries, compilation into IDE-native files, content hashes, MCP exposure, tamper-evident logging, provenance, policy checks, and reproducible configuration artifacts.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It reinforces treating request packages, tools, skills, and workflow configuration as governed artifacts with stable provenance rather than ad hoc prompt text.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Keep broad MCP and product details upstream, but consider local governance language for hash-addressed instructions, compiled agent artifacts, and tamper-evident tool logs.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route product or framework background upstream; keep only local control-plane practice here.

qualifying_updates.title: Same Scrutiny, More Time: Eye Tracking Insights into Reviewing LLM-Labelled Code
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: A 32-participant eye-tracking study found reviewers spent more fixation time on code labeled as LLM-generated while maintaining similar review thoroughness, and many used the prompt as a requirement or contextual artifact during review.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It gives review-eval and request-package leaves evidence that prompts and provenance labels can materially shape human review behavior and should be available to reviewers.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Review rubrics may need to require prompt/provenance availability when evaluating AI-generated code and reviewer behavior.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding prompt-as-review-artifact language during the next ingest pass.

qualifying_updates.title: Evaluate LLM and agent quality in Dynatrace AI Observability with dt-evals
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Dynatrace describes dt-evals as an open-source CLI for scoring real GenAI traces with bring-your-own LLM judge providers, writing structured evaluation results back to observability, and supporting offline, online, and CI quality gates.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It provides a concrete public operating pattern for connecting judge outputs, trace provenance, retrieval context, tool calls, latency, cost, and alerting.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Keep vendor/product specifics upstream, but capture the local practice of tying eval scores to trace, retrieval, tool-call, cost, and latency evidence.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Check whether judge-grader-boundaries should mention BYO judge provider governance and trace-linked eval results.

qualifying_updates.title: Build an AI second brain for engineering teams
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The guide frames engineering memory as codebase decisions, review history, team standards, linked tickets, and cross-file dependencies surfaced at review time, and warns that commit-history-only memory misses senior-reviewer knowledge held in discussions.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It reinforces local leaves about code retrieval, RAG provenance, source reconciliation, and code-review rubrics with a current public argument for graph-based, workflow-surfaced engineering context.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Treat vendor-specific claims as upstream-owned, but consider local synthesis around durable review memory, discussion provenance, and graph-based retrieval as practice implications.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Pair with existing context-architecture pages if synthesized later.
